svg.title: Multi-Agent Loan Intelligence System — complete pipeline flowchart
svg.desc: End-to-end flowchart from three raw datasets through offline training, LangGraph multi-agent inference, to final audit PDF. Two lanes: offline (top) and online inference (bottom).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Lending Club dataset and why we use it for uplift modelling')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the IEEE-CIS fraud detection dataset')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Home Credit default risk dataset')
sendPrompt('Explain the Lending Club data preparation steps in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain the IEEE-CIS data preparation steps')
sendPrompt('Explain the Home Credit data preparation and table aggregation steps')
sendPrompt('Explain the feature engineering steps for the uplift model — rate_sensitivity, debt_burden, income_adequacy')
sendPrompt('What feature engineering is done for the IEEE-CIS fraud model?')
sendPrompt('What feature engineering is done for the Home Credit credit risk model?')
sendPrompt('Explain how the X-Learner uplift model is trained — the three stages')
sendPrompt('Explain how the LightGBM fraud classifier is trained on IEEE-CIS data')
sendPrompt('Explain how the LightGBM credit risk model is trained on Home Credit data')
sendPrompt('What model artifacts are saved and why does each one matter?')
g.text: xlearner_lgbm.pkl · fraud_lgbm.pkl · credit_lgbm.pkl · imputer.pkl · encoder.pkl · credit_shap_explainer.pkl

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does wrapping a model as a LangChain @tool mean and how does it work?')
g.text: uplift_tool · fraud_tool · credit_risk_tool — each loads artifacts once at startup, exposes structured dict output

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the LangGraph StateGraph and how is it compiled for our project?')
g.text: nodes wired · conditional edges defined · LoanState TypedDict schema set · graph.compile()

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens during FastAPI startup and why is artifact loading done at startup?')
g.text: @startup: all .pkl artifacts loaded into memory · /health · /metrics · /evaluate-loan endpoints registered

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Streamlit frontend do and how does LangSmith tracing work?')
g.text: Streamlit UI ready · LangSmith tracing active

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does a loan application JSON payload look like when it hits the API?')
g.text: loan_amnt · fico · dti · annual_inc · grade · purpose · term · home_ownership · emp_length

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Pydantic validation work in our FastAPI endpoint?')
g.text: types checked · missing fields rejected · 422 returned on failure

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the LangGraph shared TypedDict state and what does it contain at initialisation?')
g.text: applicant_features set · all other fields None · graph.invoke(state) called

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Credit Risk Agent use its LightGBM model to score an application?')
sendPrompt('How does the Fraud Detection Agent score an application using LightGBM?')
sendPrompt('Why does the Uplift Agent run after Credit Risk and Fraud, not in parallel with them?')
sendPrompt('Explain all the supervisor conditional routing rules — what triggers each decision path?')
g.text: Supervisor — read state · apply conditional edges
CI wide → human review · else → run uplift agent
Persuadable → approve+rate · Sure Thing → approve · Lost Cause → decline

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What fields does the supervisor write to shared state after making a decision?')
g.text: decision · decision_reason → approve_with_rate / approve_standard / decline / human_review

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Explainability Agent work — SHAP computation, LLM call, and PDF generation?')
g.text: SHAP TreeExplainer on credit model → top 3 factors
reportlab PDF → decision + scores + SHAP chart + narrative + LangSmith trace ID

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does LangSmith capture in a trace and why does it matter for regulatory compliance?')
g.text: per-agent inputs · outputs · timing · trace ID embedded in PDF

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is in the final JSON response and the PDF audit report that the API returns?')
g.text: JSON: decision · default_probability · fraud_score · uplift_score · segment
PDF audit report: full compliance document for download
